messages:
olivia_cs: customer reports AWS Accelerator grant appears on their AWS invoice but balance in Redwood subaccount is unchanged. attached invoice screenshot and order id.
marie_chen: thanks. can you drop the AWS order id, payer account id, and the Redwood org id? we'll audit entitlement flow.
olivia_cs: Order: 6677-8899-0001
olivia_cs: AWS payer account: 333444555666
olivia_cs: Redwood org id: org_05KLMNO (they say usage happened in subaccount acct_05K_USAGE)
emily_z: I pulled webhook logs: received marketplace_entitlement.posted at 2027-12-11T16:08:21Z. payload.amount_cents=25000, product_code=redwood-accel-elite. webhook => 200 OK, sig verified. internal queue entq_7755.
ledger-bot: ledger_entry_created: id=led_001122 applied_to=acct_legacy_002 amount_cents=25000
sanjay_patel: interesting — applied_to looks like an old account id from our legacy migration mapping. customer recently migrated between orgs and we have a historical mapping for the AWS payer email.
marie_chen: can you run the entitlement row dump? want to see raw fields (aws_account_id, payer_account_id, buyer_email, applied_to_account_id).
emily_z: running quick query: GET /internal/marketplace/entitlements?order_id=6677-8899-0001
emily_z: returned -> aws_account_id: null, payer_account_id: 333444555666, buyer_email: billing+marketplace@customer.com, product_code: redwood-accel-elite, applied_to_account_id: acct_legacy_002, processed_at: 2027-12-11T16:09:05Z
sanjay_patel: root cause: webhook payload omitted linked_account and aws_account_id; our fallback logic maps by buyer_email -> org. buyer_email still resolves to the customer's legacy org in our contacts table, so the credit landed on acct_legacy_002 instead of acct_05K_USAGE.
billing-ops: creating ticket BO-7812. Plan: 1) reversible ledger reversal on acct_legacy_002 2) reapply credit to acct_05K_USAGE 3) run recon diff and append note to org billing history 4) notify customer. ETA ~5 business hours.
partners_eng: reaching out to AWS partner team. AWS notes accelerator grants sometimes populate buyer contact only in OrderMetadata instead of top-level linked_account fields for consolidated billing. asking them to also include linked_account_id for grant events.
olivia_cs: customer asked for timeline — I told them ~5 hours and that we'll email once complete.
emily_z: uploaded webhook payload + processing trace to ticket: https://redwood-support.s3.amazonaws.com/attachments/2890012341/entitlement_trace.png
billing-ops: manual reversal and reapply complete. run id recon_20271211_07. debited acct_legacy_002 $250.00; credited acct_05K_USAGE $250.00. ledger diff net zero. BO-7812 resolved.
olivia_cs: emailed customer with ledger screenshots and explanation. customer confirmed credits now visible in their subaccount and usage deducted from the credited amount. :thumbsup:
marie_chen: post-mortem items: 1) add defensive lookup in entitlement processor to consult order metadata->buyerIdentity->linked_account_id when aws_account_id null 2) add rule to avoid mapping by legacy buyer_email if the resolved org is marked migrated/archived 3) emit alert when applied_to_account_id resolves to an org with status != active 4) add unit tests for consolidated-billing accelerator flows.
partners_eng: also opening a sync with AWS to request more consistent linked_account fields for accelerator grants. PR to entitlement-mapping in progress: https://git.internal.redwood.com/r/entitlement-mapping/+/489
sanjay_patel: filing ENG-1410 for the processor change and telemetry. thanks all.
olivia_cs: closing thread after confirmation from customer. :eyes:
